title: Canonical Postnikov exact couple
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories, and suppose D(A) is a derived category with its standard t-structure. For every homological T:D(A)→B, there exists a PostnikovCoupleData T: the canonical successive-truncation arrows are exact, the layer comparison is normalized on cohomology, and the E2 comparison is the coherent single-functor shift comparison. The witness interfaces are defined in [def-per-postnikov-additive-witness-data].

source.place: Homology Tag 011Q: exact-couple definition; Derived Categories Tag 08J5: canonical successive-truncation triangle. The degree convention is the project E2 convention.

proof.text: Construct the unique layer map inducing the truncation homology comparison; homology is fully faithful on objects concentrated in degree q, so it is a natural isomorphism with the stated normalization. Apply the three exact positions of the shifted homology sequence to the canonical truncation triangle. Transport endpoints along equal total degrees. Use the canonical Postnikov objects and arrows as the initial couple and compose the coherent single-functor shift comparisons for E2. Uses [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle], [def-per-postnikov-truncation-couple-terms].

proof_origin.place: Tags 011Q, 011R, 011S and 0AMJ, with the canonical Postnikov triangles of derived.tex Tag 08J5; explicit additive-functor argument.
